title: Canonical Fact
description: One atomic, time-aware assertion about one field on one canonical entity, with explicit evidence and history links.

id.description: Permanent UUID for this individual assertion; Fact IDs are never reused or reassigned.

schema_version.description: Version of the Fact contract used to validate this record.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this immutable historical Fact record was first created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest metadata or lifecycle update; observed_value itself is never overwritten.

source_ids.description: One or more Source IDs providing direct provenance; an empty or unresolved set is invalid.

confidence_score.description: Current evidence-strength assessment from 1 through 5; later review may change confidence without erasing history.

status.description: Controlled observation and review lifecycle state; transitions are governed by docs/FACT_LIFECYCLE.md.

notes.description: Optional clarification of scope, ambiguity, disagreement, or review reasoning; never a substitute for structured provenance.

entity_type.description: Canonical entity collection containing the subject of this assertion.

entity_id.description: UUID of the subject record in the collection named by entity_type; validated as a typed foreign key.

field_name.description: Stable snake_case field path being asserted, such as planned_capacity_mw; it identifies meaning without embedding the Fact in the entity.

observed_value.description: Atomic observed, estimated, or derived value. Interpretation is governed by field_name, unit, status, dates, and provenance.

unit.description: Explicit measurement unit for quantitative values, such as MW, years, USD, or decimal_fraction; null only for inherently unitless values.

observation_date.description: Date this value was first observed in the cited evidence, answering when the repository first knew the assertion.

effective_date.description: Date the assertion became true in the real world; null when evidence does not establish an effective date.

superseded_by_fact_id.description: Fact ID that directly replaces this assertion; null unless status is superseded.

supersedes_fact_ids.description: Fact IDs directly replaced by this assertion; old Facts remain permanently stored and queryable.

input_fact_ids.description: Fact IDs used as reproducible calculation inputs; required and non-empty when status is derived.

derivation_method.description: Reproducible formula or versioned transformation reference for a derived Fact; null for non-derived Facts.

estimation_method.description: Method and assumptions used for an estimated Fact; null for non-estimated Facts.
